summary: Master Logistics 4.0 and warehouse automation. Learn to implement AGVs, WMS, and IoT to optimize supply chain throughput. Enroll now for expert-led training.
lede: Logistics 4.0 brings connected systems, data, and automation into warehouse and supply chain operations. For experienced logistics and distribution professionals, the course addresses how to plan and integrate warehouse automation, including connecting WMS and ERP data, evaluating robotics and automated storage, and designing real-time tracking and predictive maintenance approaches.
audienceIntro: This advanced program is tailored for experienced professionals responsible for the strategic direction and operational efficiency of modern distribution centers and global supply chains.
audience: Industrial Engineers focused on warehouse layout
modules: Foundations of Logistics 4.0 and Industry Trends
Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Data Integration
Robotics and Autonomous Systems in Fulfillment
AI and Predictive Analytics in Warehousing
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 5 years of experience in logistics or warehouse management. A working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and basic supply chain financial concepts (ROI, CAPEX) is required. No programming knowledge is necessary, but familiarity with data analytics is beneficial.
